 Analysis
 UC Davis hosts Alabama State in a matchup that heavily favors the home side. The simulation leans decisively toward UC Davis, projecting a game shaped by pace and efficiency—Alabama State will need to stay close in a low-scoring environment to have a realistic path to an upset. On games where the model has favored one side this strongly, that side won 91% of the time across 815 graded contests. For Alabama State to pull off the road win, the Hornets would need to generate enough offensive pressure to keep UC Davis from controlling the tempo, a tall task against a Aggies team built to defend at home.
